free_tier.stated: Box Starter, free for nonprofits via TechSoup validation: 'Secure file collaboration, storage and native e-signatures for up to 10 users | 100 GB of storage | 2 GB file upload'. The first-party nonprofit page states 'donated Plan' for Starter and 'up to 10 perpetual licenses for Box Starter edition'. 100 GB shared per org.

egress.terms: No egress meter on Box downloads documented on the nonprofit page.

record.tooling: rclone backend 'box' (Tier 1, server-side copy); Box Content API.
record.chaining: 100 GB x one nonprofit org, with 10 perpetual seats sharing that 100 GB. Not 100 GB per seat. Paid Business/Enterprise are 50% off, which is a discount not a grant, so this does not reach 500 GB free.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 2 GB per upload. request-rate: Box API per-app throttling. retention: 'perpetual licenses'. No expiry, which is unusual and worth noting.
record.reliability_note: Perpetual license model provides 100 GB aggregate storage without expiration.
